description: A dispatcher needs to remember recurring route exceptions such as temporary closures, alternate stops, construction detours, and seasonal access changes that affect one school route. All districts and routes are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 43-year-old transportation dispatcher overseeing several school routes with frequent local disruptions
user_profile.context: The official route map is stable, but daily reality includes enough exceptions that drivers still need a reliable memory aid
user_profile.communication_style: Operational and route-focused, wants recurring exceptions separated from one-off incidents

fact_sheet.fact: Route 12 is designated for students attending Northwood Elementary School.
The operating district for Route 12 is the Maple Creek School District.
The standard morning departure time for Route 12 from the main depot is 6:45 AM.
The primary driver assigned to Route 12 is Maria Garcia.
Elk Ridge Road is closed to all school bus traffic from December 1st to March 15th annually due to hazardous winter conditions.
The approved winter detour for the Elk Ridge Road closure is via Aspen Drive to Pine Street, rejoining the route at Hilltop Lane.
The winter detour for Elk Ridge Road adds approximately 12 minutes to the Route 12 morning schedule.
The spring reopening of Elk Ridge Road must be confirmed by a road condition report from the Aspen Falls County Public Works department, report code 'RC-CLEAR'.
The Oak Street Bridge is closed for a reconstruction project with a scheduled completion date of October 31, 2024.
The official detour for the Oak Street Bridge closure is east on Willow Avenue, south on 5th Street, and west on Chestnut Boulevard.
Bus stops #12-08 (Oak & 2nd) and #12-09 (Oak & 4th) are suspended for the duration of the Oak Street Bridge construction.
A temporary stop, #12-08T, has been established at the corner of Willow Avenue and 3rd Street to accommodate students from the suspended stops.
The municipal construction project ID for the Oak Street Bridge is AF-CONST-2024-07B.
Main Street, between First Avenue and Third Avenue, is closed every Friday from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM for the weekly farmer's market.
The Friday morning detour for the Main Street closure is to use Cedar Street, which runs parallel one block north.
The Friday Main Street closure affects stop #12-04; students are instructed to use stop #12-03 at Main & First Avenue.
The farmer's market on Main Street operates seasonally from May 1st through September 30th each year.
An alternate pickup stop is required for student Liam Miller (Student ID: 481516) every Tuesday morning.
Liam Miller's alternate pickup location is the Maple Creek Community Clinic at 789 Healthway Drive.
The scheduled pickup time for Liam Miller at the clinic is exactly 7:55 AM on Tuesdays.
Liam Miller's parent, Sarah Miller, must confirm the alternate pickup via the ParentLink app by 8:00 PM the prior evening, or the bus defaults to the home stop.
The reason code on file for Liam Miller's alternate stop is 'MED-RECUR', for recurring physical therapy appointments.
The assigned vehicle for Route 12 is Bus #207, a 2022 Blue Bird Vision model.
Bus #207 has a maximum passenger capacity of 72 elementary school students.
All real-time updates and exception alerts for Route 12 are posted in the dispatch Slack channel `#route12-alerts`.
The official radio call sign for the bus operating Route 12 is 'Badger 12'.
Driver Maria Garcia is required to confirm receipt of any same-day route changes via a 'copy that' radio call back to dispatch.
A daily route exception summary must be emailed to the substitute driver pool alias `sub_drivers@maplecreek.edu` by 5:30 AM.
The district's official routing and scheduling software is RouteOptix Pro version 4.1.
The login URL for the RouteOptix Pro dispatcher portal is https://maplecreek.routeoptix.com/login.
The in-vehicle navigation and communication tablet assigned to Bus #207 is a Samsung Galaxy Tab Active3, asset tag #MCSD-T3-045.
The primary contact at Northwood Elementary for attendance and student drop-off issues is front desk administrator Susan Bell at 555-0102.
The Maple Creek School District Transportation Manager is David Chen, reachable at extension 4501 for route emergencies or schedule approvals.
